text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000530's 99215 rate stays elevated even among patients with no chronic conditions, a claims pattern consistent with upcoding, but documentation is too thin to confirm it.","leaning":"pattern_consistent_with_upcoding","interpretation":"The sicker-panel explanation is weakened because the elevated 99215 share holds in every complexity stratum, not just the complex ones, and the sampled low-complexity 99215s include routine presentations such as upper respiratory infection (C0259752, C0260660, C0260846) and rash (C0259580).
